generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Construct the code, model, prompt, etc. for validating the POC.

contract.purpose_user_function: Use governed implementation worker nodes to create code, model/prompt/configuration, or other artifacts that realize the verification plan.
contract.valid_inputs: Compiled task graph, requirement/experiment plan, source workspace, allowed tools/commands, input artifacts, write scopes, and proof obligations.
contract.expected_outputs: Implementation artifacts/patches plus logs, manifests, and evidence required by downstream tests and verification.
contract.state_side_effects: Modifies only authorized workspace paths and publishes node artifacts/evidence to sprint state.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Worker/graph execution fails or escalates on runtime error, unauthorized writes/actions, missing inputs, unmet proof obligations, or artifact publication failure.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic code-building nodes are supported; models/prompts/hardware POCs depend on available workers/tools and are not uniformly implemented.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/tools/codex_pm_router.py::_short_task_graph, _standard_task_graph` creates ImplementationWorker nodes and `harness/lib/graph_node_dispatcher.py` publishes their artifacts.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test code, configuration, prompt/model artifact, allowed write, forbidden write, missing input, runtime failure, evidence publication, and idempotent rerun.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Basic Workflow; README.md#Governed Planning; README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands; docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/tools/codex_pm_router.py planner surface; harness/lib/graph_node_dispatcher.py runtime dispatch surface
contract.platform_provider_limitations: The repository has a generic governed coding/test graph, not a domain-general first-class POC lifecycle or `poc_bundle` schema.
